role_mapping_policy: Only exact single-token UTF16 match. PROPN maps to coarse noun, not entity approval. AUX maps to verb. Composite tags preserved, not silently collapsed.

failures.rationale: send email action; later email address is separately protected

scope: Frozen nominated roles on116 reused diagnostic sources, not population accuracy. No Android runtime qualification.

process_metrics.measurement: JVM /proc/self/status; whole process high-water resident memory, not heap or launcher historical rusage

scope_limits: JVM21 on Linux; no Android/Dalvik/R8/minSdk check
POS scores not calibrated sense confidence
No NER model or idiom recognizer
Raw POS output includes composite UD tags such as PRON+AUX; preserve them
No release/runtime approval; no automatic9535 expansion

cross_platform_comparison.not_a_ranking: Different systems, runtimes and raw conventions on selected diagnostics; no population accuracy or phone latency ranking.

important_limits: planes incorrect VERB has raw score0.9804; a high score does not ensure even coarse-role correctness.
visit correct VERB0.996 can contradict noun dictionary metadata, but cannot approve target form or sense.
Dorothy AUX0.415; GA Tech both NOUN; Fruits PROPN/Baskets NOUN. POS is not a general entity/title protector.
URLs/email may be single lexical tokens with PROPN/NOUN tags; use identifier masks independently.
Composite tags such as PROPN+PART preserved; Apple may split differently, so exact-range mismatches are annotation-convention differences, not automatic role errors.
